name: receive_goods
title: Receive goods
description: Record goods received (GRN) against a RELEASED purchase order: stock goes up, and the order closes once everything has arrived. Cannot receive more than was ordered.

po_no.description: the released order the goods came against

warehouse.description: optional; defaults to the order's warehouse

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step
